scope: Source-backed readiness, not measured SOTA efficacy. Task2 performs new actual MorphX numerical qualification.

candidates.name: MorphX
positive: Author runtime/compiler and PD workload scripts are public; existing LLVM18/SM89 mapped-host port can execute selected rewritten kernels.
boundaries: PD scripts call modified LLMEngine.get_prefill_result/wait_prefill_shutdown and enable VLLM_PREFILL_THREAD; author environment records local source vLLM0.1.dev24+g232ce74 and Torch2.6.0a0. The complete public tree does not bundle that modified vLLM/PyTorch tree; current installed stock vLLM has no matching API occurrences.
NInfer's existing single worker/prefill-lane executor does not become concurrent author PD scheduling merely through LD_PRELOAD.
Prior mapped-host port remains numerically unqualified for GDN cooperative launch/GQA; targeted corrections and actual probes are required.
candidates.decision: Prioritize actual launch-semantics/numerical qualification. Do not report a kernel-only hook as complete MorphXPD or infer performance from compatibility failure.

candidates.name: BulletServe
positive: P/D weights use CUDA IPC sharing via init_rpc_model_weight; claiming two full weight copies would be incorrect.
Public P/D scheduler, SM control and request/KV RPC exist.
boundaries: Complete tree has Qwen3 attention-only models but no Qwen3_5 native class. Registry can select TransformersForCausalLM fallback, so missing native class alone is not proof the whole model is rejected.

Generic fallback states one attention operation per hidden layer; RPC pool types transfer request tables and MHA K/V, without a GDN/SSM recurrent-state handoff in the inspected code. Existing hybrid-cache branch is Llama4 local/full attention rather than GDN.
Author prerequisites include MPS and libsmctrl/CUDA<=12.6; do not invoke stock scripts defaulting to GPU0.
candidates.decision: Bounded actual CPU contract/fallback inspection before installing another stack; do not fake Qwen3_5 with attention-only Qwen3 or claim model-level OOM from duplicated weights.

candidates.name: DuetServe
candidates.decision: Do not manufacture a reproduction or treat third-party implementations/paper speedups as measurements.

candidates.name: SGLang PD-Multiplexing
candidates.decision: Reuse exact archived measured evidence and new solo audit. This is an advanced open-source baseline, not an established universal SOTA ceiling.
